_sources.note: Size, shape and reference plane of each orbit: JPL mean elements. Where the moon is along it: fitted to JPL Horizons over 2000 to 2040 by scripts/data/fit-moon-orbits.py; orbit.fit gives the error in degrees as seen from the planet. Good for drawing where a moon is, not for navigation. Radii and masses exist only for moons a spacecraft or a good telescope has measured.
